On day *Wùzǐ*,
Sòng, Gāolì, and Xiàguó each sent envoys to offer condolences and sacrifices.
On day *Jiǎwǔ*,
Rén Yì Huánghòu was interred at Qìnglíng.
On day *Jǐhài*,
stopped the imperial carriage at Tuōgǔliè.
On day *Rényín*,
Wèiwáng (Prince of Wei) Yēlǜ Yǐxīn, the Běiyuàn Shūmìshǐ, was dismissed and appointed Zhōngjīng Liúshǒu.
On day *Dīngwèi*,
Consort Xiāo was installed as Empress;
her father, Zhīhòu Lángjūn (Gentleman Attendant) Biēlǐlà, was enfeoffed as Zhào Wáng (Prince of Zhao);
her uncle, Xīběilù Zhāotǎoshǐ (Commissioner of Pacification of the Northwest Circuit) Yúlǐyě, was enfeoffed as Liáoxī Jùnwáng (Prince of Liáoxī Commandery);

her elder brother, Hànrén Xínggōng Dūbùshǔ (Chief Commissioner of the Han People's Traveling Palace) and Fùmǎ Dūwèi (Commandant-Escort) Xiámò, was enfeoffed as Liǔchéng Jùnwáng (Prince of Liǔchéng Commandery).
Cānzhī Zhèngshì (Adviser to the Government) Yáng Zūnxù was put in charge of the Nányuàn Shūmìshǐ affairs;
Běiyuàn Shūmì Fùshǐ (Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Northern Chancellery) Xiāo Sùsā was put in charge of the Běiyuàn Shūmìshǐ affairs;
and Hànrén Xínggōng Fùbùshǔ (Vice Commissioner of the Han People's Traveling Palace) Liú Shēn was made Cānzhī Zhèngshì.
On day *Jǐyǒu*,
Nánfǔ Zǎixiàng (Chancellor of the Southern Administration) Zhào Huī retired from office.
Autumn, the seventh month, day *Wùchén*,
went to Qiūshān.
On day *Guǐyǒu*,
Liǔchéng Jùnwáng Xiámò passed away.
The eighth month, day *Gēngyín*,
while hunting,
encountered a fawn that had lost its mother;
feeling compassion for it,
he did not shoot.
The ninth month, day *Wùwǔ*,
because of the locusts in Nánjīng,
rent and taxes for the following year were exempted.
On day *Jǐmǎo*,
stopped the imperial carriage at Ǒusī Diàn.
Winter, the tenth month, day *Wùxū*,
Wèiwáng Yēlǜ Yǐxīn, the Zhōngjīng Liúshǒu, was recalled to serve again as Běiyuàn Shūmìshǐ.
The eleventh month, day *Jiǎxū*,
the Emperor wished to view the *Qǐjū Zhù* (Diaries of Activity and Repose),
but the Compiler-Reporters (Xiūzhù Láng) [name missing] and Hūtúntǐn refused to present them.
They were each beaten with 200 strokes,
dismissed,
and Línyá (Grand Academician) Xiāo Yánshòu was exiled to the Wūwěi Department.
In this month,
Nánjīng experienced an earthquake,
and many civilian houses were destroyed.
In the twelfth month, on the day Jǐchǒu,
Xiāo Tàbùyě, Left Yílíbì, was made Commander-in-Chief of Nánjīng.
In the third year, spring, first month, on the day Guǐchǒu,
he went to the Hùntóng Jiāng (River).
On the day Yǐmǎo,
the annual tribute of gold and silk from various circuits was reduced,
and the silver that had been delivered to the Shàngfāng (Imperial Workshop) throughout the year was suspended.
Second month, on the day Rénwǔ, the first of the month,
Xiāo Hánjiānú, Commander-in-Chief of the Northeast Circuit, was promoted to Shàngfù,
and enfeoffed as King of Wú.
On the day Jiǎshēn,

an edict decreed that Dànú and Āsī, the elder brother and younger brother of the same mother as Yēlǜ Yǐxīn, Prince of Wèi and Commissioner of the Northern Chancellery of Military Affairs, should be consistently chosen for selection in the Northern and Southern Chancellery of Military Affairs,
and his step-brothers should be consistently chosen for selection as Yílíjǐn.
On the day Jǐchǒu,
he went to Yu'ér Luò (Lake).
On the day Xīnmǎo,
as there was a famine in Zhōngjīng,
the imperial tour was suspended.
Summer, fourth month, on the day Yǐyǒu,
he sailed a boat on the Hēilóng Jiāng (River).
Fifth month, on the day Bǐngchén,
locust nymphs (yuán) damaged the crops in Yùtián and Āncì.
On the day Guǐhài,
there was a dark spot (sunspot) in the sun.
On the day Jǐsì,
the imperial carriage halted at Dú Shān (Mount Dú).
On the day Yǐhài,
Yēlǜ Yǐxīn, Commissioner of the Northern Chancellery of Military Affairs, submitted a memorial stating that
Zhālà, Guards Grand Guardian, and others informed Xiāo Sùsā and eight others, Officials of the Northern Chancellery of Military Affairs, that they were plotting to establish the Heir Apparent.
The emperor deemed the accusation baseless
and did not prosecute them.
Sùsā and three others were sent out to take external posts;
Sābō and six other Guards received over a hundred strokes each
and were exiled to the border.
On the day Bǐngzǐ,
Xiāo Yúliyě, Prince of Liáoxī Commandery and Northwest Circuit Pacification Commissioner, was made Northern Palace Chancellor,
and concurrently put in charge of the affairs of the Khitan Traveling Palace General Command.
On the day Wùyín,
an edict ordered that those who reported acts of treason
should receive great official rewards.
Sixth month, on the day Jǐmǎo, the first of the month,
Xiāo Èduōwò, a Palace Guard (lángjūn) holding the commissioner’s token and seal (lìngyìn), falsely accused Sùsā and others of having previously participated in the conspiracy,
and submitted their names on a register.
Yǐxīn, Yēlǜ Zhòngxǐ, Xiāo Yúliyě, Yēlǜ Xiàojié, Yáng Zūnxù, Yāngē, Chāozhǐ, and Xiāo Shísān were immediately ordered to conduct the interrogation and trial.
The Heir Apparent was flogged
and imprisoned in the palace.
On the day Xīnsì,
Dílǐlà and three other officers on night duty were killed.
On the day Rénwǔ,
Tàbùyě and two other Commissioners of the Bureau of the Court of Official Merits (Xuānhuī Shǐ) were killed.
On the day Guǐwèi,
Sālà and ten others, Military Commissioners of Shǐpíng Army, were killed.
An envoy was also sent to kill Sùsā, the Resident of Shàngjīng,
and Sābō and six others of the Guards who had already been exiled.
On the day Yǐyǒu,
Yēlǜ Tàbùyě and his younger brother Chénliú were killed.
On the day Bǐngxū,
the Heir Apparent was deposed as a commoner (shùrén)
and imprisoned in Shàngjīng.
On the day Jǐchǒu,
the Huíhú (Uighurs) came to present tribute.
Yēlǜ Huílǐbù, Concurrent Supervisor of the Resident of Dōngjīng, was killed.
On the day Xīnmǎo,
Sùsā's sons and others were killed,
and their families' property was confiscated.
On the day Wùshēn,
an envoy was sent to review the prisons in the Five Capitals and various circuits.
Autumn, seventh month, on the day Xīnhài,
Zhālà, Guards Grand Guardian, was promoted to Pacifying Grand General,
and selected for the post of Military Commissioner of the Tūlǚbù tribe.
The Shìwěi Zhālà, Xiāo Bǎoshénnú, and Móulǔgǔ were all promoted to Grand General of the Left Guard.
Èduōwò, the Palace Guard holding the commissioner’s token and seal, married Princess Zhàoguó, the imperial daughter,
and was granted the title of Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-Law (Fùmǎ Dūwèi) and Military Commissioner of Shǐpíng Army.
Yēlǜ Tàbùyě and Xiāo Túgǔcí, Palace Guards on Duty (zhīhòu lángjūn), were both promoted to Supreme General of the Gate Guard.
On the day Rénzǐ,
Xiāo Hánjiānú, Concurrent Vice-Commissioner of the Northern Chancellery of Military Affairs, was made General Commander of the Traveling Palace for the Han People.
On the day Yǐchǒu,
he went to Qiū Shān (Autumn Mountain).
On the day Dīngchǒu,
he paid respects at Qìnglíng (Mausoleum).
Eighth month, on the day Gēngyín,
Xiāo Hánjiānú, General Commander of the Traveling Palace for the Han People, passed away.
On the day Xīnchǒu,
he paid respects at Qìnglíng (Mausoleum).
Ninth month, on the day Guǐhài,
Yùtián presented auspicious grain (jiāhé) as tribute.
On the day Rénshēn,
the temple at Qiánlíng (Mausoleum) was repaired.
Winter, tenth month, on the day Xīnchǒu,
the imperial carriage halted at Ǒusī Diàn (Pond).
Eleventh month,
Yēlǜ Yǐxīn, Commissioner of the Northern Chancellery of Military Affairs, sent his personal attendant to secretly kill Jùn, the commoner (shùrén), in Shàngjīng.
Intercalary twelfth month, on the day Wùwǔ,
Xiāo Yúliyě, Prince of Liáoxī Commandery and Northern Palace Chancellor, was put in charge of the affairs of the Northern Chancellery of Military Affairs.
Yēlǜ Yāngē, Left Yílíbì, was made General Commander of the Khitan Traveling Palace.
On the day Bǐngyín,
the New Year's Day ceremony was rehearsed.
In this year,
Nánjīng had a great harvest.
Fourth year, spring, first month, on the day Gēngchén,
he went to the Spring Water (Chūn Shuǐ).
On the day Jiǎwǔ,
relief was distributed for the famine in Dōngjīng.
Second month, on the day Yǐchǒu,
the imperial carriage halted at Sǎohuò Yě (Field).
On the day Wùchén,
Yēlǜ Wángjiǔ, Commander-in-Chief of the Eastern Circuit, was made Tìyǐn.
Summer, fourth month, on the day Xīnhài,
Gāolì (Koryŏ) sent an envoy to request the grant of territory east of the Yālù Jiāng (River),
which was refused.
Fifth month, on the day Bǐngxū,
the imperial carriage halted at Sǎnshuǐ Yuán (Plateau).
Sixth month, on the day Jiǎyín,
the chieftains of the Zǔbǔ (Tatar) presented fine horses.
Autumn, seventh month, on the day Jiǎxū,
various circuits reported having fed 360,000 Buddhist monks and nuns.
Eighth month, on the day Guǐmǎo,
an edict ordered the relevant officials to resolve delayed judicial cases.
Ninth month, on the day Yǐwèi,
the imperial carriage halted at Ǒusī Diàn (Pond).
On the day Gēngzǐ,
the tribal chiefs of the Five Nations came to present tribute.
Winter, tenth month, on the day Guǐmǎo,
Liú Shēn, Participant in Determining Government Affairs, was made Military Commissioner of Bǎojìng Army.
Eleventh month, on the day Dīnghài,
officials and commoners were forbidden from wearing brocade and damask with designs of the sun, moon, mountains, or dragons.
On the day Jǐchǒu,
the Huíhú (Uighurs) sent an envoy to present tribute.
On the day Gēngyín,
Yēlǜ Zhòngxǐ, Commissioner of the Southern Chancellery of Military Affairs, was made Military Commissioner of Guǎngdé Army.
On the day Xīnmǎo,
Zhāng Bǎo of Jǐnzhōu had four generations living together (sì shì tóng jū).
His sons were ordered to serve as Guards on Duty in the Three Departments Bureau.
Twelfth month, on the day Dīngmǎo,
Yēlǜ Mù, Vice-Commissioner of the Northern Chancellery of Military Affairs, was put in charge of the affairs of the Northern Chancellery of Military Affairs.
Main Annals, Volume 24: Dàozōng 4
Fifth year, spring, first month, on the day Rénshēn,
he went to the Hùntóng Jiāng (River).
On the day Guǐyǒu,
Yēlǜ Xiàojié, the Chancellor, was granted the personal name Rénjié.
On the day Yǐhài,
he went to Shānyú Diàn (Pond).
Third month, on the day Xīnwèi,
because Rénjié, the Chancellor, captured the first goose (tóu'é),
he was promoted to Grandee-Secretary (Shìzhōng).
On the day Rénchén,
Yēlǜ Yǐxīn, Prince of Wèi and Commissioner of the Northern Chancellery of Military Affairs, was put in charge of the affairs of the Southern Palace Grand King,
and promoted to Yúyuè.
Yēlǜ Mù, who was in charge of the affairs of the Northern Chancellery of Military Affairs, was made Commissioner of the Northern Chancellery of Military Affairs.
Yēlǜ Tèlǐdǐ, Vice-Commissioner of the Northern Chancellery of Military Affairs, was put in charge of the affairs of the Northern Chancellery of Military Affairs.
Yēlǜ Shìqiān, Left Yílíbì, was made Concurrent Supervisor of the Affairs of the Northern Chancellery of Military Affairs.
Summer, fourth month, on the day Jǐwèi,
he went to Nàgě Luò (Lake).
Fifth month, on the day Dīnghài,
he paid respects at Qìnglíng (Mausoleum).
Yēlǜ Yāngē, General Commander of the Khitan Traveling Palace, was made Southern Palace Chancellor.
Yēlǜ Yǒngníng, Northern Face Secretary (Línyá), was made Yílíbì.

Xiāo Tàbùyě, Concurrent Supervisor of the Southern Chancellery of Military Affairs, and Xiāo Chóuwò, Vice-Inspector-in-Chief of the Palace Guard and Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-Law, were both enfeoffed as Prince of Lánlíng Commandery.
Sixth month, on the day Xīnhài,
the Zǔbǔ (Tatar) came to present tribute.
On the day Dīngsì,
Xiāo Yúliyě, Prince of Liáoxī Commandery and Northern Palace Chancellor, was made Northwest Circuit Pacification Commissioner.
On the day Jǐwèi,
an envoy was sent to record prisoners.
In this month,
113 Presented Scholars (jìnshì), including Liú Guàn, were released (or graduated).
Autumn, seventh month, on the day Jǐmǎo,
he hunted at Jiā Shān (Mount Jia).
Eighth month, on the day Gēngshēn,
the relevant officials were ordered to compose the Inscription on the Divine Merit of Tàizōng,
to be erected in Nánjīng.
Ninth month, on the day Jǐmǎo,
an edict forbade all circuits from restricting monks from establishing Dharma altars.
On the day Rénwǔ,
the imperial entourage was forbidden from harassing the people.
Winter, tenth month, on the day Wùxū,
the Xià (Tangut) state sent an envoy to present tribute.
On the day Jǐhài,
the imperial carriage halted at Dúlújīn.
On the day Rénzǐ,
an edict decreed that only the imperial sons (huángzǐ) should retain single-character king titles;
all others were reduced in rank.
On the day Dīngsì,
relief was distributed to the poor people of Píngzhōu.
On the day Jǐwèi,
Yáng Jì, King of Zhào, was reduced in rank to Prince of Liáoxī Commandery.
Yēlǜ Yǐxīn, Prince of Wèi, was reduced in rank to Prince of Hùntóng Commandery.
Xiāo Hánjiānú, King of Wú, was reduced in rank to Prince of Lánlíng Commandery
and retired from office.
Eleventh month, on the day Dīngchǒu,
the Buddhist monk Shǒudào was summoned to establish a Dharma altar in the inner palace.
On the day Guǐwèi,
the corvée labor and duties for the displaced people (liúmín) of Nánjīng were deferred for three years,
and households affected by fire were exempted from rent and taxes for one year.
In the twelfth month, on the day Bǐngwǔ
, a comet entered the Wěi asterism.
On the day Yǐmǎo
, [the Emperor] proceeded to Xījīng.
On the day Wùwǔ
, the Rite of Rebirth (Zàishēng Lǐ) was performed
, and those guilty of various capital offenses (and lesser crimes) were pardoned.
In the sixth year, spring, the first month, on the day Guǐyǒu
, [the Emperor] went to Yuānyāng Luò.
On the day Xīnmǎo
, Yēlǜ Yǐxīn was sent out to govern Xīngzhōng Fǔ.
In the third month, on the day Gēngyín
, the Imperial Grandson Yánxǐ was enfeoffed as the Prince of Liáng (Liáng Wáng);
Yēlǜ Pōdé, Commissioner of Zhōngshùn Army, was made Grand King of the Southern Chancellery (Nányuàn Dàwáng);
Yēlǜ Zhòngxǐ was made Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Southern Chancellery (Nányuàn Shūmìshǐ);
and Chén Yì, Minister of Revenue (Hùbù Shǐ), was made Vice-Administrator (Cānzhī Zhèngshì).
Summer, the fourth month, on the day Yǐmǎo
, [the Emperor] hunted at Tàn Shān.
The fifth month, on the day Rénshēn
, the taxes and levies were exempted for one year for the people in Píngzhōu who had returned to their livelihoods.
On the day Gēngyín
, due to the drought
, prayers were offered for rain.
[The Emperor] ordered his attendants to splash water upon one another
, and immediately, rain fell.
The sixth month, on the day Wùxū
, the imperial carriage halted at Nàgě Luò.
On the day Wùshēn
, Wáng Jì, Minister of Revenue (Dùzhī Shǐ), was made Vice-Administrator (Cānzhī Zhèngshì).
On the day Gēngxū
, the Nǚzhí sent envoys to present tribute.
Autumn, the seventh month, on the day Wùchén
, [the Emperor] observed the marketplace.
On the day Guǐwèi
, six Qígǔ Zhuālà guards were established to protect the Imperial Grandson, the Prince of Liáng (Liáng Wáng), Yánxǐ.
On the day Jiǎshēn
, [the Emperor] hunted at Shā Lǐng.
Intercalary ninth month, on the day Rén'yín
, sacrifice was offered at Mùyè Shān.
On the day Jǐyǒu
, the imperial carriage halted at Ǒusī Diàn.
Winter, the tenth month, on the day Jǐwèi (New Moon)
, the acting Commissioner of Guǎngdé Army was dismissed
, and the Commissioner of Fèngxiān Army was ordered to concurrently patrol and guard Qián and Xiǎn prefectures.
On the day Dīngmǎo
, Yēlǜ Rénjié was sent out as the Commissioner of Wǔdìng Army.
On the day Gēngwǔ
, Liú Shēn, Vice-Administrator, retired from office.
On the day Guǐyǒu
, Chén Yì was made Grand Commissioner of the Hán People's Traveling Palace,
and Wáng Jì was made Acting Commissioner of Military Affairs (Tóngzhī Shūmìyuàn Shì).
On the day Xīnsì
, the Huíhú (Uighurs) sent envoys to present tribute.
The eleventh month, on the day Jǐchǒu (New Moon)
, there was a solar eclipse.
On the day Guǐmǎo
, the multitude of officials were summoned to discuss government affairs.
The twelfth month, on the day Jiǎzǐ
, Yēlǜ Tèlǐdǐ was made Mèngfù Chǎngwěn.
On the day Yǐchǒu
, Xiāo Tàbùyě was made Chancellor of the Northern Residence (Běifǔ Zǎixiàng);
Yēlǜ Shìqiān was made Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Northern Chancellery (Zhī Běiyuàn Shūmìshǐ Shì);
and Yēlǜ Shènsī was made Acting Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Northern Chancellery (Tóngzhī Běiyuàn Shūmìshǐ Shì).
On the day Gēngwǔ
, the taxes and levies were exempted for one year for the displaced people of Xījīng.
On the day Jiǎxū
, the people's levies were reduced.
On the day Dīnghài
, the New Year's Day (Zhēngdàn) Rites were performed in advance.
On the day Wùzǐ
, [the Emperor] went to Hùntóng Jiāng.
In the seventh year, spring, the first month, on the day Wùshēn
, the chiefs of the Five Nations (Wǔ Guó) came to present tribute.
On the day Jiǎyín
, the Nǚzhí presented fine horses as tribute.
The second month, on the day Jiǎzǐ
, [the Emperor] went to Yú'ér Luò.
Summer, the fifth month, on the day Rénzǐ
, the imperial carriage halted west of the ridge (Lǐngxī).
On the day Guǐchǒu
, officials reported that locusts had infested the three counties of Yǒngqīng, Wǔqīng, and Gù'ān.
On the day Jiǎyín
, Xiāo Tàbùyě was concurrently made Grand Inspector of the Palace Guards (Diànqián Dōu Diǎnjiǎn),
and Xiāo Chóuwò was made Grand Commissioner of the Hán People's Traveling Palace concurrently acting as Commissioner of Military Affairs.
The sixth month, on the day Jiǎzǐ
, an edict mandated monthly sacrifices at Guāndé Diàn
, and annually, on the Cold Food Festival (Hánshí)
and on the birthdays and death anniversaries of all previous Emperors while they were alive
, offerings were to be made at Jǐngzōng Yùróng Diàn.
On the day Bǐngyín
, Yúgǔnǎn of the Zǔbǔ came to present tribute.
On the day Dīngmǎo
, Wáng Yánfū, Academician of the Hanlin Academy, was made Vice-Administrator (Cānzhī Zhèngshì);
Shídǔ, Controller-General of the Northern Chancellery (Běiyuàn Xuānhuīshǐ), was enfeoffed as Prince of Qīshuǐ Commandery.
Autumn, the seventh month, on the day Wùzǐ
, [the Emperor] went to Qiū Shān.
On the day Bǐngshēn
, [the Emperor] visited Qìng Líng.
The eighth month, on the day Dīngmǎo
, [the Emperor] shot deer at Chì Shān,
and Niègě, the Hunting Ground Commissioner (Wéichǎng Shǐ), was promoted to Commissioner of Jìngjiāng Army.
The ninth month, on the day Wùzǐ
, [the Emperor] reached Huáizhōu
, and commanded the Empress to visit Huái Líng.
On the day Xīnmǎo
, [the Emperor] reached Zǔzhōu
, and commanded the Empress to visit Zǔ Líng.
On the day Yǐsì
, the imperial carriage halted at Ǒusī Diàn.
Winter, the tenth month, on the day Wùchén
, Wáng Jiǔ, the Tìyǐn, was made Grand King of the Southern Chancellery (Nányuàn Dàwáng);
Xī Chāozhī, the Yílíbì, was made Commissioner of Zhāngguó Army.
The eleventh month, on the day Yǐyǒu
, an edict mandated the annual expenditure of official funds
to relieve poor households in various palaces (gōngfēn) and frontier garrisons (biānshù).
On the day Dīnghài
, [the Emperor] visited the residence of the Imperial Son-in-Law (Fùmǎ Dūwèi), Xiāo Chóuwò.
While drinking
, the Chancellor, Liáng Yǐng, remonstrated, saying:
"The Son of Heaven must not drink at the house of a subject."
The Emperor immediately returned to the palace.
On the day Jǐhài
, Gāolì (Goryeo) sent envoys to present tribute.
On the day Xīnhài
, the regulation setting narrow or short dimensions for silk cloth was abolished.
The twelfth month, on the day Dīngmǎo
, Yēlǜ Rénjié, Commissioner of Wǔdìng Army, was stripped of his rank and reduced to commoner status due to crimes.
On the day Xīnwèi
, Yēlǜ Yǐxīn, Governor of Xīngzhōng Fǔ, was imprisoned in Láizhōu for crimes.
In the eighth year, spring, the first month, on the day Jiǎshēn
, [the Emperor] went to Hùntóng Jiāng.
On the day Dīngyǒu
, the chiefs of the Tiělí and the Five Nations (Wǔ Guó) each presented local products as tribute.
The second month, on the day Wùwǔ
, [the Emperor] went to Shānyú Diàn.
On the day Xīnyǒu
, an edict instructed the officials of the Northern and Southern Chancellery
that all who were granted post-station services (yì)
must first submit a report.
Only for presenting tribute or newly arrived items, or submitting court cases and grievances
, was permission granted to use the post stations hastily
; all others were forbidden.
On the day Jǐsì
, the Xià State, having captured the Sòng General Zhāng Tiānyī
, sent envoys to present him.
On the day Rénshēn
, Yēlǜ Pōdé was made Chancellor of the Southern Residence (Nánfǔ Zǎixiàng) concurrently acting as Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Northern Chancellery;
Yāngē was made Tìyǐn;
and Xiāo Tàbùyě was concurrently made Acting Grand Commissioner of the Qìdān Traveling Palace.
The third month, on the day Gēngxū
, Zhúnǎi, the Nǚzhí chief of Huánglóng Fǔ, led his tribesmen to submit internally
; he was granted office
and awarded an official seal and ribbon.
In this month
, an edict mandated the use of the measure standards (shēng and dòu) based on the black millet (jùshǔ) standard.
Summer, the fourth month, on the day Rénxū
, Yēlǜ Shìqiān was made Resident Administrator of Shàngjīng.
The sixth month, on the day Xīnhài (New Moon)
, the imperial carriage halted at Nàgě Luò.
On the day Bǐngchén
, the Xià State sent envoys to present tribute.
On the day Dīngsì
, Yēlǜ Pōdé was made Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Northern Chancellery (Běiyuàn Shūmìshǐ);
Yēlǜ Cháogē was made Chancellor of the Southern Residence (Nánfǔ Zǎixiàng);
Liú Yún was made Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Southern Chancellery (Nányuàn Shūmìshǐ);
Xiāo Tàbùyě was concurrently made Acting Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Northern Chancellery;
Wáng Jì was made Grand Commissioner of the Hán People's Traveling Palace;
and Xiāo Chóuwò was made Maternal Uncle Xiángwěn.
On the day Yǐchǒu
, the chief of the Zǔbǔ came to present tribute.
On the day Bǐngzǐ
, Yēlǜ Shènsī was made Acting Right Yílíbì.
Autumn, the seventh month, on the day Jiǎwǔ
, [the Emperor] went to Qiū Shān.
Continuous rain fell in Nánjīng.
The Shā Hé overflowed
, flooding the six counties of Yǒngqīng, Guīyì, Xīnchéng, Āncì, Wǔqīng, and Xiānghé
, damaging the crops.
, [the Emperor] visited Qìng Líng.
On the day Dīngwèi
, the imperial carriage halted at Ǒusī Diàn.
There was a great snowstorm
, and many cattle and horses died.
Clothing and horses were granted, in varying amounts, to the officials accompanying the Emperor and those below them.
Winter, the tenth month, on the day Yǐmǎo
, an edict commissioned Huàgē
as tutor and guide to the Prince of Liáng (Liáng Wáng), Yánxǐ, and he was promoted to Grand General of the Palace Guard (Jīnwú Wèi Dàjiāngjūn).
On the day Bǐngzǐ
, [the Emperor] visited Qián Líng.
The eleventh month, on the day Rénwǔ
, Xiāo Hégě, the Yǐshì Grand King, was made Controller-General of the Southern Chancellery (Nányuàn Xuānhuīshǐ);
Túgǎn, who was provisionally managing the affairs of the Grand King of the Six Xī Divisions, was made Grand King of that Division.
The twelfth month, on the day Guǐchǒu
, Yēlǜ Mǎwǔ, Commanding Officer of the Wūgǔ Díliè, was made Grand King of the Northern Chancellery (Běiyuàn Dàwáng).
On the day Gēngshēn
, the Empress was demoted to Consort Huì (Huì Fēi)
, and sent out to reside at Qián Líng.
In the ninth year (1073), spring, the first month, on the day Xīnsì,
[The Emperor] went to Chūnshuǐ.
Summer, the fourth month, on Bǐngwǔ (the first day of the month),
there was a great snowfall.
The snow on the level ground was over a *zhàng* deep,
and sixteen or seventeen tenths of the horses died.
The fifth month,
[The Emperor] went to Hēilǐng.
The sixth month, on the day Jǐwèi,
the imperial procession stopped at Sànshuǐ Yuán.
On the day Jiǎzǐ,
Yēlǜ Āsī was appointed Qìdān Xínggōng Dū Bùshǔ,
and Yēlǜ Shènsī was appointed Běiyuàn Shūmì Fùshǐ.
On the day Gēngwǔ,
an edict was issued to officials across all circuits to investigate and register absconded households (*tuōhù*).
Those whose crimes warranted death
were pardoned.
Intercalary month, on the day Dīngchǒu,
Kèhánnú, the Assistant Commander of the Hànrén Xínggōng, was made Nányuàn Dàwáng.
On the day Wùyín,
the commoner Jùn was posthumously honored with the title Zhāohuái Tàizǐ.
On the day Dīnghài,
the Zǔbǔ came to pay tribute.
On the day Jǐchǒu,
Xíng Xīnián, who was managing the affairs of Xīngzhōng Fǔ, was appointed Hànrén Xínggōng Dū Bùshǔ,
and Wáng Jì, the Hànrén Xínggōng Dū Bùshǔ, was appointed Nányuàn Shūmì Fùshǐ.
Autumn, the seventh month, on the day Yǐsì,
[The Emperor] hunted at Mǎwěi Shān.
On the day Dīngsì,
[The Emperor] paid respects at Qìng Líng.
On the day Guǐhài,
outside officials were prohibited from lending money at interest within their jurisdiction, and envoys were forbidden from lodging in commoners' homes.
The eighth month,
Wáng Huī, the King of Gāolì, passed away.
The ninth month, on Guǐmǎo (the first day of the month),
there was a solar eclipse.
On the day Jǐyǒu,
a bear was shot at Báishí Shān,
and Niègé, the Director of the Hunting Ground (*wéichǎng shǐ*), was promoted to Zuǒ Jīnwú Wèi Dà Jiāngjūn.
On the day Jǐsì,
Wáng Xūn, the Sān Hánguó Gōng and son of the deceased King Huī of Gāolì, was made acting manager of state affairs.
On the day Xīnwèi,
the chiefs of the Five States came to pay tribute.
On the day Rénshēn,
officials of the Běi and Nán Shūmì Yuàn were summoned to deliberate on governmental affairs.
Winter, the tenth month, on the day Dīngchǒu,
[The Emperor] paid respects at Guāndé Diàn.
On the day Jǐmǎo,
Liú Yún, the Nányuàn Shūmì Shǐ, passed away.
On the day Rénchén,
Yēlǜ Yǐxīn, the Hùntóng Jùnwáng, plotted to flee and defect to Sòng,
and was executed.
The eleventh month, on the day Bǐngwǔ,
Yánxǐ, the Prince of Liáng, was promoted in rank and enfeoffed as Yān Guó Wáng,
and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
Xiāo Hégě, the Nányuàn Xuānhuī Shǐ, was made Nánfǔ Zǎixiàng.
Wáng Jīng, the Director of the Three Bureaus (*sānsī shǐ*), was appointed Cānzhī Zhèngshì jiān Zhī Shūmì Shì.
On the day Jiǎyín,
an edict instructed the monk Shànzhī to proofread the Buddhist scriptures presented by Gāolì
and circulate them.
On the day Jǐwèi,
the promotion grades for all clerks (*lìng shǐ*) and interpreters (*yì shǐ*) were established.
The twelfth month, on the day Dīnghài,
Xíng Xīnián was appointed to manage the affairs of the Nányuàn Shūmì Shǐ.
On the day Xīnmǎo,
Wáng Yánfū was appointed Hànrén Xínggōng Dū Bùshǔ.
Wáng Xūn, the Sān Hánguó Gōng of Gāolì, passed away.
That year,
fifty-one *jìnshì*, including Lǐ Jūnyù, were graduated in the Imperial Presence.
The tenth year (1074), spring, the first month, on Xīnchǒu (the first day of the month),
[The Emperor] went to Chūnshuǐ.
On the day Bǐngwǔ,
the pagoda of Nánjīng Fèngfú Sì was rebuilt.
On the day Wùchén,
[The Emperor] went to Shānyú Diàn.
The second month, on Gēngwǔ (the first day of the month),
Ménggǔ Guó sent an envoy to offer condolences and tribute.
The third month, on the day Wùshēn,
Yuǎnménggǔ Guó sent an envoy to offer condolences and tribute.
On the day Dīngsì,
Wáng Shīrú, the Compiler of Imperial Edicts (*zhī zhìgào*), and Yēlǜ Gù, the Tablet and Seal Minister (*páiyìn lángjūn*), were commanded to serve as tutors and guides for Yān Guó Wáng Yánxǐ.
Summer, the fourth month, on the day Dīngchǒu,
the Nǚzhí offered fine horses as tribute.
The fifth month, on the day Rénxū,
the imperial procession stopped at Sànshuǐ Yuán.
On the day Yǐchǒu,
the Zǔbǔ came to pay tribute.
On the day Bǐngyín,
the rank of Guójiù Xiángwěn (Imperial Maternal Uncle Marshal) was lowered to be subordinate to that of the Chǎngwěn.
The sixth month, on the day Rénchén,
the destruction of copper coins to make utensils was prohibited.
Autumn, the seventh month, on the day Jiǎchén,
[The Emperor] went to Hēilǐng.
The ninth month, on the day Guǐhài,
the imperial procession stopped at Ǒusī Diàn.
Winter, the twelfth month, on the day Yǐwèi,
Qìngzhōu Dà'ān Jūn was renamed Xīngpíng.
In this month,
the following year was renamed Dà'ān (Great Peace era),
and a general amnesty was granted for crimes below capital punishment.
Dà'ān, the first year (1075), spring, the first month, on the day Dīngyǒu,
[The Emperor] went to Hùntóng Jiāng.
On the day Guǐmǎo,
Wáng Jì was appointed to manage the affairs of the Nányuàn Shūmì Shǐ,
and Xíng Xīnián was made Zhōngjīng Liúshǒu (Resident Administrator of the Central Capital).
On the day Wùshēn,
Dù Gōngwèi, a Scholar of the Bureau of Military Affairs (*shūmì zhí xuéshì*), was appointed Cānzhī Zhèngshì.
On the day Gēngxū,
the chieftains of the Five States came to pay tribute with fine horses.
The second month, on the day Xīnwèi,
[The Emperor] went to Shānyú Diàn.
Summer, the fourth month, on the day Yǐyǒu,
Sòng Zhǔ Xū died.
His son Xù succeeded to the throne,
and sent an envoy to report the mourning.
On the day Xīnmǎo,
[The Emperor] traveled west.
The sixth month, on the day Wùchén,
the imperial procession stopped at Tuōgǔliè.
On the day Rénshēn,
Wáng Jì was appointed Nánfǔ Zǎixiàng,
and Xiāo Tàbùyě concurrently managed the affairs of the Nányuàn Shūmì Shǐ.
On the day Dīngchǒu,
an envoy was dispatched to the Sòng to offer condolences and sacrifices.
On the day Wùyín,
Sòng sent Wáng Zhēn, Zhēn Yòu, and others to present gifts left by their former emperor.
Autumn, the seventh month, on the day Yǐsì,
an envoy was dispatched to congratulate the Sòng ruler on his enthronement.
On the day Wùwǔ,
[The Emperor] hunted at Chì Shān.
The eighth month, on the day Dīngmǎo,
[The Emperor] toured Qìngzhōu.
On the day Wùchén,
[The Emperor] paid respects at Qìng Líng.
Winter, the tenth month, on the day Guǐhài,
the imperial procession stopped at Hǎocǎo Diàn.
On the day Wùchén,
Lǐ Bǐngcháng, the King of Xià Guó, sent an envoy to report the mourning for his mother, Lady Liáng.
On the day Jiǎshēn,
Xiāo Tàbùyě was appointed Nányuàn Shūmì Shǐ.
The eleventh month, on the day Yǐwèi,
an edict stated:
"Recently,
outside officials have been promoted in rank due to praise,
but then not transferred for a long time,
causing harm to the populace.
Hereafter, all promotions and transfers shall be based on qualifications (*zī jí*)."
On the day Dīngyǒu,
Xiāo Páolǐ, the Nán Nǚzhí Xiángwěn, was appointed Běifǔ Zǎixiàng.
On the day Xīnhài,
the historians presented the Veritable Records for the seven emperors from Tàizǔ onward.
On the day Bǐngchén,
an envoy was sent to enthrone Yùn, the younger brother of Sān Hánguó Gōng Wáng Xūn, as the King of Gāolì.
On the day Jǐwèi,
an edict prohibited monks and nuns from entering the palace without reason.
The twelfth month, on the day Jiǎxū,
Sòng sent Cài Biàn to express thanks for the condolences and sacrifices.
The second year (1076), spring, the first month, on the day Xīnmǎo,
[The Emperor] went to Hùntóng Jiāng.
On the day Jǐyǒu,
the various chiefs of the Five States came to pay tribute.
On the day Guǐchǒu,

Zhào Xiàoyán, the Acting Scholar of the Hanlin Academy (*quán hànlín xuéshì*), Wáng Shīrú, the Compiler of Imperial Edicts, and others were summoned to lecture on the major principles of the Five Classics.
The second month, on the day Guǐyǒu,
the imperial procession stopped at Shānyú Diàn.
In this month,
Venus eclipsed Jupiter.
The third month, on the day Yǐyǒu,
the Nǚzhí offered fine horses as tribute.
Summer, the fourth month, on the day Wùxū,
[The Emperor] traveled north.
On the day Guǐchǒu,
an envoy was sent to promote Xiāo Éduō, the General Commander (*tǒngjūn shǐ*), to Tàizǐ Tàibǎo;
Lǎogǔ, the Deputy General (*píjiāng*), to Jīnwú Wèi Dà Jiāngjūn;
Xiāo Yǎgē to Jìngjiāng Jūn Jiédùshǐ;
and Yēlǜ Yānnú to Yòu Jiānmén Wèi Dà Jiāngjūn.
Furthermore, gifts were bestowed upon all the soldiers.
The fifth month, on Dīngsì (the first day of the month),
because the number of horses bred had increased greatly, reaching a million,
officials in charge of herds were rewarded,
and promoted according to their rank.
On the day Yǐhài,
the imperial procession stopped at Nàgě Luò.
On the day Wùyín,
Liáng Yǐng, the Chancellor, was sent out to manage the affairs of Xīngzhōng Fǔ.
In this month,
twenty-six *jìnshì*, including Zhāng Gǔ, were graduated.
*dīnghài* day, the first day of the month,
Yélǜ Tǎn, the Zuǒ Yílíbì, was appointed as Tìyǐn.
Yélǜ Wòtèlá, the Zhī Shūmìyuàn Shì, concurrently took charge of the affairs of the Zuǒ Yílíbì.
*Bǐngshēn* day,
the Zǔbǔ came to court.
*Guǐmǎo* day,
envoys were dispatched to inspect the prisons across all circuits.
*Jiǎchén* day,
Yélǜ Nàyě, the Tóng Zhī Nánjīng Liúshǒu Shì, was appointed to take charge of the affairs of the Yòu Yílíbì.
*Yǐsì* day,
the Zǔbǔ chieftains Yúgǔnǎn and Àide came to court.
An imperial edict ordered Yān Guówáng Yánxǐ to form a bond of friendship with them.
*Wùshēn* day,
Yélǜ Āsī, the Qìdān Xínggōng Dūbùshǔ, concurrently took charge of the affairs of the Běiyuàn Dàwáng.
*Rénzǐ* day,
the brothers and sons of officials from the rank of Gāodūn down to County Magistrate (xiànlìng) and Recorder (lùshì),
were all permitted to be employed.
Autumn, Seventh month,
*dīngsì* day,
Xuēgǔ, the mother of Huìfēi and Yān Guófūrén, was implicated in using black magic against Liáng Wáng and was discovered,
resulting in her execution.
Her son, Lánlíng Jùnwáng Xiāo Chóuwò, was stripped of his title
and exiled to a border commandery (jùn),
but remained affiliated with the Xīngshèng Gōng.
*Wùwǔ* day,
a hunt was held at Shā Lǐng.
*Jiǎzǐ* day,
money was bestowed upon the poor people of the two palaces, Xīngshèng and Jìqìng.
*Yǐyǒu* day,
grain was distributed to relieve the poor people of Liáozhōu.
Eighth month, *wùzǐ* day,
the hunt was canceled due to snow.
Ninth month, *gēngwǔ* day,
returned to Shàngjīng.
*Rénshēn* day,
grain was issued to relieve the poor people of Shàngjīng and Zhōngjīng.
*Bǐngzǐ* day,
worshipped at the Èryí and Wǔluán Palaces (diàn).
*Jǐmǎo* day,
the armor and weapons used by Tàizǔ and Tàizōng were taken out and shown to Yān Guówáng Yánxǐ,
instructing him on the difficulty of founding the dynasty and undertaking military campaigns.
*Xīnsì* day,
the Nánfǔ Zǎixiàng was summoned to discuss state affairs.
Winter, Tenth month, *yǐyǒu* day, the first day of the month,
Dòu Jǐngyōng, the Shūmì Fùshǐ, was appointed to take charge of the affairs of the Shūmìyuàn.
*Bǐngxū* day,
the tribal chiefs of the Wǔ Guó came to offer tribute.
*Dīnghài* day,
because Xià Guówáng Lǐ Bǐngcháng had died,
an envoy was sent with an edict appointing his son, Qiánshùn, to manage the affairs of the state.
Eleventh month, *jiǎxū* day,
the Rebirth Ceremony was performed for Yān Guówáng Yánxǐ,
and a partial amnesty was granted to the prisoners in Shàngjīng.
*Wùyín* day,
Gāolì dispatched an envoy to express thanks for the enfeoffment and investiture.
*Guǐwèi* day,
grain was issued to relieve the poor people of the four prefectures: Qiánzhōu, Xiǎnzhōu, Chéngzhōu, and Yìzhōu.
Twelfth month, *xīnmǎo* day,
Lánlíng Jùnwáng Xiāo Tăbùyě was appointed Nányuàn Shūmìshǐ.
*Jǐhài* day,
Xià Guówáng Lǐ Qiánshùn dispatched an envoy to present the relics of his late father.
Basic Annals 25: Dàozōng 5
Third Year, Spring, First month, *yǐmǎo* day,
went to Yú’ér Luò.
*Jiǎxū* day,
money and grain were issued to relieve the poor people of Nánjīng,
and their rents and taxes were remitted.
*Jǐmǎo* day,
there was heavy snow.
Second month, *bǐngxū* day,
grain was issued to relieve the famine in Zhōngjīng.
*Jiǎchén* day,
because many people had scattered and fled,
the law requiring settled fugitive households to pay compensation was abolished.
Third month, *yǐmǎo* day,
Gāolì dispatched an envoy to offer tribute.
*Jǐwèi* day,
the poor people of Jǐnzhōu were exempted from rent for one year.
*Jiǎxū* day,
the poor people of Shàngjīng were exempted from rent, similarly to those in Jǐnzhōu.
*Gēngchén* day,
the Nǚzhí presented fine horses as tribute.
Summer, Fourth month, *wùzǐ* day,
silk was bestowed upon the poor people of Zhōngjīng,
and half of the tribute payments from all circuits was remitted.
*Bǐngshēn* day,
silk was bestowed upon the poor people of the Wēi Wūgǔ tribe.
*Gēngzǐ* day,
went to Liángxíng.
*Jiǎchén* day,
Wáng Jì, the Nánfǔ Zǎixiàng, died.
*Yǐsì* day,
an imperial edict ordered the release of grain from the Hùbù Sī (Ministry of Revenue),
to relieve the refugees across the various circuits and the famine in Yìzhōu.
Fifth month, *gēngshēn* day,
Hǎiyún Sì (Temple) contributed ten million in currency for relief purposes.
Autumn, Seventh month, *bǐngchén* day,
a hunt was held at Hēilǐng.
*Dīngsì* day,
various silks were issued and bestowed upon the poor people of the Xīngshèng Gōng.
*Gēngwǔ* day,
heavy rain fell,
and the hunt was canceled.
*Dīngchǒu* day,
Qín Yuè Guówáng Āliǎn died.
Ninth month, *yǐhài* day,
the imperial entourage halted at Xiálǔjīn.
Winter, Tenth month, *gēngchén* day,
Wáng Jīng, the Cānzhī Zhèngshì, was appointed Sānsī Shǐ.
*Rénchén* day,
officials from the Jiédùshǐ rank downwards were prohibited from presenting rare curios.
*Guǐmǎo* day,
Qín Yuè Guówáng Āliǎn was posthumously enfeoffed as Qín Wèi Guówáng.
Eleventh month, *jiǎyín* day,
Yélǜ Tǎn, the Tìyǐn, was appointed Tóng Zhī Nánjīng Liúshǒu Shì,
and Yélǜ Wángjiǔ, the Liáoxīngjūn Jiédùshǐ, was appointed Nánfǔ Zǎixiàng.
Twelfth month, *jǐmǎo* day, the first day of the month,
Lǚ Sìlì, the Shūmì Zhíxuèshì, was appointed Cānzhī Zhèngshì.
Fourth Year, Spring, First month, *gēngxū* day,
went to Hùntóng Jiāng.
*Jiǎyín* day,
Venus was visible during the day.
*Jiǎzǐ* day,
the tribal chiefs of the Wǔ Guó came to offer tribute.
*Gēngwǔ* day,
taxes and levies were remitted for the fugitive and poor households in Shàngjīng.
*Jiǎxū* day,
due to famine in Shàngjīng and Nánjīng,
good people were permitted to sell themselves.
*Dīngchǒu* day,
a partial amnesty was granted to the laborers in Xījīng.
Second month, *jǐchǒu* day,
went to Yú’ér Luò.
*Jiǎwǔ* day,
a partial amnesty was granted to the laborers in Chūnzhōu;
those sentenced to life service were all released after five years.
*Jǐhài* day,
went to Chūnzhōu.
An amnesty was granted to the laborers in Tàizhōu.
Third month, *yǐchǒu* day,
Gāolì's annual tribute was remitted.
*Jǐsì* day,
relief was provided for the famine in Shàngjīng and the three prefectures: Píngzhōu, Jǐnzhōu, and Láizhōu.
Summer, Fourth month, *jǐmǎo* day,
relief was provided for the poor people in the five prefectures: Sūzhōu, Jízhōu, Fùzhōu, Lùzhōu, and Tiězhōu,
and their rents and taxes were all remitted.
*Jiǎshēn* day,
relief was provided for the poor people of Qìngzhōu.
*Yǐyǒu* day,
the amount of ordinary tributary goods, especially clothing and imperial articles, collected from all circuits was reduced.
*Dīngyǒu* day,
the law allowing one to obtain office by contributing grain was established.
*Guǐmǎo* day,
the Emperor traveled west.
Yélǜ Yǎn, the Shūmì Zhíxuèshì, was summoned to lecture on the "Hóngfàn" chapter of the *Shàngshū*.
Fifth month, *xīnhài* day,
Yān Guówáng Yánxǐ was ordered to transcribe the "Wǔzǐ zhī Gē" (Song of the Five Sons) chapter of the *Shàngshū*.
*Yǐmǎo* day,
relief was provided for the poor people of Zǔzhōu.
*Dīngsì* day,
an imperial edict ordered the release of laborers;
those sentenced to life service were released after five years.
*Jǐwèi* day,
relief was provided for the poor people of Chūnzhōu.
*Bǐngyín* day,
the private channeling of water that damaged cultivated fields was forbidden.
Sixth month, *gēngchén* day,
the imperial entourage halted at Sǎnshuǐ Yuán.
*Dīnghài* day,
Yān Guówáng Yánxǐ was ordered to take charge of the affairs of the Zhōngchéng Sī,
Yélǜ Nièlǐ, the Tóng Zhī Nányuàn Shūmìshǐ Shì, was appointed Zhī Yòu Yílíbì,
and Yélǜ Nàyě, the Zhī Yòu Yílíbì Shì, was appointed Tóng Zhī Nányuàn Shūmìshǐ Shì.
*Gēngyín* day,
Yélǜ Pǒdé, the Běiyuàn Shūmìshǐ, retired from office.
Autumn, Seventh month, *wùshēn* day,
a partial amnesty was granted to the laborers in Fèngshèngzhōu.
*Bǐngchén* day,
an envoy was sent to investiture Lǐ Qiánshùn as Xià Guówáng.
*Gēngshēn* day,
went to Qiūshān.
*Jǐsì* day,
the export of currency outside the borders was forbidden.
Eighth month, *gēngchén* day,
the relevant authorities reported that the locusts in Wǎnpíng and Yǒngqīng had been eaten by flying birds.
*Gēngyín* day,
paid respects at Qìnglíng (Mausoleum).
Winter, Tenth month, *dīngchǒu* day,
a hunt was held along the banks of the Liáoshuǐ.
*Jǐmǎo* day,
the imperial entourage halted at Ǒusī Diàn.
*Guǐwèi* day,
the official grain borrowed by the populace was remitted.
*Jǐchǒu* day,
Yélǜ Āsī, the Zhī Běiyuàn Shūmìshǐ Shì, was enfeoffed as Qīshuǐ Jùnwáng.
*Guǐsì* day,
Yélǜ Díliè, the Yǐshì Dàwáng, was appointed to take charge of the affairs of the Xīběilù Zhāotǎoshǐ,
and Xiāo Xiǔgē, the acting Zhī Xīběilù Zhāotǎoshǐ Shì, was appointed to take charge of the affairs of the Yǐshì Dàwáng.
*Rényín* day,
an imperial edict ordered all circuit chiefs to personally interrogate lawsuits and prison cases.
In the eleventh month, on the *gēngshēn* day,
Zhāng Huàfǎ (張化法), a resident of Xīngzhōng Fǔ (興中府), requested to die in place of his father and elder brother, who were guilty of robbery and sentenced to death.
He requested substitution,
and they were all pardoned.
In the twelfth month, on the *wùyín* day,
the Chancellor of the Southern Administration (Nán Fǔ Zǎixiàng), Yēlǜ Wángjiǔ (耶律王九), retired.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
Mèngfù Chǎngwěn (孟父敞穩), Yēlǜ Shènsī (耶律慎思), was appointed Defender-in-chief of the Central Capital (Zhōngjīng Liúshǒu).
On the first day of the intercalary twelfth month, *guǐmǎo*,
the New Year's Day ceremony was performed preemptively.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
[the Emperor] went to Hùntóng Jiāng (混同江).
In the spring of the fifth year, first month, on the *guǐwèi* day,
[the Emperor] went to Yú'ér Luò (魚兒濼).
On the *jiǎwǔ* day,
Gāolì (高麗) sent an envoy to present tribute.
In the third month, on the *guǐyǒu* day,
an edict ordered Xījīn Fǔ (析津府) and Dàdìng Fǔ (大定府) to carefully select candidates for report,
and further decreed to scholars,
that they must exhaust the study of the Classics and illuminate the Way (*Dào*).
Summer, fourth month, on the *jiǎchén* day,
Niègě (涅葛), who was administering the affairs of the Great King of the Six Xī Departments (Zhī Xī Liù Bù Dà Wáng Shì), was appointed Great King of the Department (Běn Bù Dà Wáng).
On the *rénzǐ* day,
[the Emperor] hunted at Běi Shān (北山).
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
heavy continuous rain fell,
and the hunt was called off.
Fifth month, on the *dīnghài* day,
[the Emperor] stopped his carriage at Chìlè Líng (赤勒嶺).
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
Móɡǔsī (磨古斯) of the Zǔbǔ (阻卜) was appointed Chief of the various Tribal Leaders.
On the *guǐsì* day,
the Huíhú (回鶻) sent an envoy to present fine horses as tribute.
On the *jǐhài* day,

Yēlǜ Nàyě (耶律那也), who was concurrently managing the affairs of the Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Southern Chancellery (Tóng Zhī Nán Yuàn Shūmì Shǐ Shì), was appointed Administrator of the Affairs of the Right Yílíbì (Zhī Yòu Yílíbì Shì).
Bān Xiángwěn (班詳穩), Yēlǜ Nièlǐ (耶律涅里), a Left Attendant Gentleman, was appointed Administrator of the Affairs of the Great King of the Northern Chancellery (Zhī Běi Yuàn Dà Wáng Shì).
Sixth month, on the *jiǎyín* day,
Xià Guó (夏國) sent an envoy to express gratitude for the formal conferment of title.
On the *rénxū* day,
Wáng Yánfū (王言敷), the Counselor of State (Cān Zhī Zhèngshì), was appointed Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs (Shūmì Fùshǐ).
Jiǎ Shìxūn (賈士勳), the former Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs, was appointed Counselor of State,
concurrently managing the affairs of the Bureau of Military Affairs (Tóng Zhī Shūmì Yuàn Shì).
Autumn, seventh month, on the *gēngwǔ* day,
[the Emperor] hunted at Shā Líng (沙嶺).
Ninth month, on the *xīnmǎo* day,
an envoy was dispatched to present dried venison to Sòng (宋).
On the *rénchén* day,
[the Emperor] stopped his carriage at Ǒusī Diàn (藕絲淀).
Winter, tenth month, on the *yǐsì* day,
because the newly established laws and regulations were too troublesome,
the old laws were reinstated.
On the *gēngshēn* day,
Hégě (何葛), the Military Commissioner (Jiédùshǐ) of Liáoxīng Jūn (遼興軍), was appointed Great King of the Yǐshì (Yǐshì Dà Wáng).
Eleventh month, on the first day, *dīngmǎo*,
Yánxǐ (延禧), the King of Yān Guó (燕國), had a son.
A general amnesty was declared,
and the relatives of the consort were promoted in rank according to differing degrees.
Spring of the sixth year, first month,
[the Emperor] went to Hùntóng Jiāng (混同江).
Second month, on the *xīnchǒu* day,
[the Emperor] stopped his carriage at Shuāng Shān (雙山).
Third month, on the *xīnwèi* day,
the Nǚzhí (女直) sent an envoy to present tribute.
Summer, fourth month, on the *dīngyǒu* day,
legal administrators (Zhǎngfǎ Guān) were established in the Tǒngjūn Sī (統軍司) of the Northeast Circuit (Dōngběi Lù).
On the *gēngzǐ* day,

Yēlǜ Tǔhuán (耶律吐𩽆), who was concurrently managing the affairs of the Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Southern Chancellery, was appointed Administrator of the Affairs of the Left Yílíbì (Zhī Zuǒ Yílíbì Shì).
Fifth month, on the *rénchén* day,
[the Emperor] stopped his carriage at Sǎnshuǐ Yuán (散水原).
Sixth month, on the *jiǎyín* day,
an envoy was dispatched to review the prisoners in the Five Capitals.
Autumn, seventh month, on the *bǐngzǐ* day,
[the Emperor] went to Hēilǐng (黑嶺).
Winter, tenth month, on the *dīngyǒu* day,
[the Emperor] stopped his carriage at Ǒusī Diàn (藕絲淀).
Eleventh month, on the *rénxū* day,
Gāolì (高麗) sent an envoy to present tribute.
On the *jǐsì* day,
Dòu Jǐngyōng (竇景庸), the Chancellor of the Southern Administration, was appointed Military Commissioner of Wǔdìng Jūn (武定軍 Jiédùshǐ).
In this year,
seventy-two *jìnshì*, including Wén Chōng (文充), were conferred degrees.
Spring of the seventh year, first month, on the *rénxū* day,
[the Emperor] went to Hùntóng Jiāng (混同江).
Second month, on the *jǐhài* day,
[the Emperor] stopped his carriage at Yú'ér Luò (魚兒濼).
On the *rényín* day,
an edict ordered the distribution of plowing oxen, cloth, and silk to the poor people of Wèizhōu (渭州).
Third month, on the *bǐngxū* day,
[the Emperor] stopped his carriage at Hēilóng Jiāng (黑龍江).
Summer, fourth month, on the *bǐngchén* day,

Yēlǜ Gǔyù (耶律谷欲), the Deputy Commander of the Hàn (漢) Imperial Traveling Palace (Hàn Rén Xíng Gōng Fù Bùshǔ), was appointed Administrator of the Affairs of the Great King of Yǐshì (Yǐshì Dà Wáng Shì).
Fifth month, on the first day, *jǐwèi*,
there was a solar eclipse.
Sixth month, on the *jiǎwǔ* day,
[the Emperor] stopped his carriage at Chìlè Líng (赤勒嶺).
On the *jǐhài* day,
people from Dǎotā Líng (倒塌嶺) presented an ancient tripod,
which bore the inscription:
"May it be used forever for ten thousand years."
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
the Huíhú (回鶻) sent an envoy to present local products as tribute.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
Xiāo Táokuí (蕭陶隗), the acting Defender-in-chief of the Eastern Capital (Quán Zhī Dōngjīng Liúshǒu), was appointed Commander-in-chief of the Qìdān (契丹) Imperial Traveling Palace (Xíng Gōng Dū Bùshǔ).
On the *dīngwèi* day,
the gates of Duāngǒng Diàn (端拱殿) suffered a calamity (fire).
Autumn, seventh month, on the first day, *wùwǔ*,
the Huíhú (回鶻) sent an envoy to present unusual articles as tribute.
They were not accepted,
but [the envoy] was richly rewarded and sent away.
Eighth month, on the *gēngyín* day,
due to continuous heavy rain,
the hunt was called off.
On the *rényín* day,
[the Emperor] visited Qìngzhōu (慶州),
and paid respects at Qìng Líng (慶陵).
Ninth month, on the *bǐngshēn* day,
[the Emperor] returned to the Supreme Capital (Shàngjīng).
On the *jǐhài* day,
the State of Rìběn (日本國) sent twenty-eight people, including Zhèng Yuán (鄭元), Zhèng Xīn (鄭心), and the monk Yīngfàn (應範), to present tribute.
Winter, tenth month, on the *xīnsì* day,
Yánxǐ (延禧), the King of Yān Guó (燕國), was appointed Grand Marshal of the Armies of the Realm (Tiānxià Bīngmǎ Dà Yuánshuài),
taking overall charge of the affairs of the Commissioners of Military Affairs of the Northern and Southern Chancellery.
Eleventh month, on the *gēngzǐ* day,
[the Emperor] went to Ǒusī Diàn (藕絲淀).
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
the sacrifice by observation was offered at Mùyè Shān (木葉山).
Spring of the eighth year, first month, on the *yǐyǒu* day,
[the Emperor] went to Shānyú Diàn (山榆淀).
On the *yǐwèi* day,
the various tribal chiefs of the Zǔbǔ (阻卜) came to surrender.
Third month, on the *jǐhài* day,
[the Emperor] stopped his carriage at Tàlǐshě Diàn (撻里捨淀).
On the *dīngwèi* day,
a partial amnesty was granted to the forced laborers in the Central Capital (Zhōngjīng) and Yùzhōu (蔚州).
Summer, fourth month, on the *yǐmǎo* day,
a Zǔbǔ (阻卜) chief came to present tribute.
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
[the Emperor] hunted at Xī Shān (西山).
Hú Lǐzhǐ (胡里只), the chieftain of the Tìdé (惕德), came to submit.
Fifth month, on the *jiǎchén* day,
[the Emperor] stopped his carriage at Chìlè Líng (赤勒嶺).
Sixth month, on the *yǐchǒu* day,
Xià Guó (夏國) was invaded by Sòng (宋),
and sent an envoy to request aid.
Autumn, seventh month, on the *dīnghài* day,
[the Emperor] hunted at Shā Líng (沙嶺).
Ninth month, on the *yǐsì* day,
[the Emperor] stopped his carriage at Ǒusī Diàn (藕絲淀).
On the *dīngwèi* day,
the State of Rìběn (日本國) sent an envoy to present tribute.
Winter, tenth month, on the first day, *gēngxū*,
an envoy was dispatched to present dried venison to Sòng (宋).
On the *bǐngchén* day,
relief was provided to the famine-stricken in the Northwest Circuit (Xīběi Lù).
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
Móɡǔsī (磨古斯) of Zǔbǔ (阻卜) killed the General of the Imperial Guard (Jīnwǔ), Tǔgǔsī (吐古斯), and rebelled.
Yēlǜ Guōsān (耶律郭三) of the Tūlǐ (禿里) of the Six Xī Departments (Xī Liù Bù) was ordered to mobilize troops from the various tributary tribes to subdue him.
On the *rénshēn* day,
Wáng Jīng (王經), the Chancellor of the Southern Administration, died.
On the *wùyín* day,
Yēlǜ Nièlǐ (耶律涅里), the Left Yílíbì, was appointed Military Commissioner of Zhāngshèng Jūn (彰聖軍 Jiédùshǐ).
Eleventh month, on the *wùzǐ* day,
Wáng Shìdūn (王是敦), the Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs, was concurrently appointed Administrator of the Affairs of the Bureau of Military Affairs (Zhī Shūmì Yuàn Shì).
Hán Zīràng (韓資讓), acting Counselor of State (Quán Cān Zhī Zhèngshì), was appointed Counselor of State.

Xī Huílǐbǎo (奚回離保), the Commander-in-chief of the Hàn (漢) Imperial Traveling Palace, was appointed Administrator of the Affairs of the Great King of the Six Xī Departments (Zhī Xī Liù Bù Dà Wáng Shì).
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
because floodwaters in Tōngzhōu (通州) had damaged the crops,
an envoy was dispatched to provide relief.
On the *wùshēn* day,
Hélǔ (合魯), the Great King of the Northern Chancellery (Běi Yuàn Dà Wáng), died.
In this year,
fifty-three *jìnshì*, including Guān Zūnwén (冠尊文), were conferred degrees.
Spring of the ninth year, first month, on the *gēngchén* day,
[the Emperor] went to Hùntóng Jiāng (混同江).
Second month,
Móɡǔsī (磨古斯) came to invade.
Third month,
Yēlǜ Ālǔsǎoɡǔ (耶律阿魯掃古), the Commissioner of Pacification and Punishment for the Northwest Circuit (Xīběi Lù Zhāotǎo Shǐ), pursued Móɡǔsī (磨古斯) but returned.
The Superintendent (Dūjiān), Xiāo Zhāngjiǔ (蕭張九), encountered the bandit [Móɡǔsī's forces],
and was unsuccessful in battle.
Many troops, including those of the Èrshìwéi (二室韋), Zhuàilá (拽剌), the Northern King's Administration (Běi Wáng Fǔ), the Tèmǎn Qúnmù (特滿羣牧), and the Gōngfèn (宮分) forces, were lost.
Summer, fourth month, on the *yǐmǎo* day,
sweet dew (*gānlù*) fell in Xīngzhōng Fǔ (興中府).
An envoy was dispatched to offer sacrifices to the Buddha and provide food to monks.
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
[the Emperor] hunted at Xī Shān (西山).
Sixth month, on the first day, *dīngwèi*,
[the Emperor] stopped his carriage at Sǎnshuǐ Yuán (散水原).
On the *gēngshēn* day,
Rónggē (榮哥), the Military Commissioner of Liáoxīng Jūn (遼興軍), was appointed Great King of the Southern Chancellery (Nán Yuàn Dà Wáng).
Yēlǜ Tǔhuán (耶律吐𩽆), who was administering the affairs of the Left Yílíbì, was appointed Left Yílíbì.
Autumn, seventh month, on the *xīnmǎo* day,
[the Emperor] went to Hēilǐng (黑嶺).
On the *rényín* day,
an envoy was dispatched to bestow sheep upon Gāolì (高麗).
Ninth month, on the *guǐmǎo* day,
relief was provided to the poor people of the Northwest Circuit (Xīběi Lù).
In winter, 10th month, *gēngxū* (day).
The relevant officials reported that Mógǔsī went to Yēlǜ Tàbùyě, the Northwest Circuit Recruiting Commissioner, pretending to surrender.
Subsequently, taking advantage of the unpreparedness, he came and attacked,
and Tàbùyě died from this.
Wūgǔzhá of the Zǔbǔ (tribe) rebelled.
The Dálǐdǐ and Básīmǔ (tribes) both plundered Dǎotā Lǐng.
On *rénzǐ* (day),
envoys were dispatched to register the soldiers of all circuits.
On *guǐchǒu* (day),
Tè mò, the King of the Southern Chancellery, was made Auxiliary Administrator of the Defender-in-chief of Nánjīng.
Zhèng Jiānú was ordered to lead troops to reinforce Dǎotā Lǐng.
On *jiǎyín* (day),
the imperial carriage stopped at Ǒusī Diàn.
Yēlǜ Tūwū, the Left Yílíbì, and Sǎbā, the Chief Administrator of the Imperial Hunting Grounds, were both appointed Military Superintendents of the Northwest Circuit.
On *yǐmǎo* (day),
an imperial edict granted three thousand horses to the Wūgǔ tribe.
On *bǐngchén* (day),
the relevant officials reported that Xiádǐ, the Zǔbǔ chief, plundered the communal herds of the Western Circuit.
On *dīngsì* (day),
relief was provided to the poor people of the Northwest Circuit.
On *jǐwèi* (day),
Yánxǐ, the King of Yān, had a son born.
A general amnesty was issued,
and the family and relatives of the consort were all promoted in rank.
On *rénxū* (day),
Zhào Tíngmù, Scholar Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Policy Counsellor and Auxiliary Administrator of the Southern Chancellery Bureau of Military Affairs.
On *guǐhài* (day),
Xiāo Xiǔgē, Military Commissioner of Wūgǔ Díliè, reported a victory in suppressing the Zǔbǔ and other tribes.
On *jiǎzǐ* (day),
Sòng dispatched an envoy to announce the mourning for Empress Dowager Cáo Shì.
An envoy was immediately dispatched to offer condolences and sacrifices.
On *jǐsì* (day),
an edict ordered the expansion of reserves and storage,
in preparation for floods and droughts.
11th month, *xīnsì* (day).
Tè mò and others reported a victory in suppressing the Zǔbǔ.
12th month, *bǐngchén* (day).
Sòng dispatched an envoy to present tribute consisting of objects left behind by the Empress Dowager.
10th year (1074 CE), Spring, 1st month.
Went to Chūnshuǐ (Spring Waters).
On *guǐwèi* (day),
Tìdé came to present tribute.
On *wùzǐ* (day),
Wūgǔzhá and others came to surrender.
The two tribes Dálǐdǐ and Básīmǔ came to invade.
Tè mò, Military Superintendent of the Sìjié Army, died from this.
2nd month, *jiǎchén* (day).
Because the Zǔbǔ were defeated,
those who rendered meritorious service were rewarded.
On *bǐngwǔ* (day),
the Southwest Recruiting Commission reported a victory in suppressing Básīmǔ.
On *guǐchǒu* (day),
Páiyǎ, Pǔlǐ, Tónggě, Hǔgǔ, Pǔguǒ, and others came to surrender.
Dálǐdǐ came to invade.
3rd month, *rénshēn* (day), beginning of the month.
There was a solar eclipse.
Xiāo Ālǔdài, Assistant Deputy Commissioner of Shānběi Circuit, reported a victory in suppressing Dálǐdǐ.
Summer, 4th month, *rényín* (day), beginning of the month.
Méngdésī and Lǎogǔdé of Tìdé, and others, each led their affiliated tribes to submit.
An edict ordered them restored to their former lands.
On *jiǎchén* (day),
the imperial carriage stopped at Běipíng Diàn in Chūnzhōu.
On *bǐngwǔ* (day),
Yēlǜ Chénjiānú, Military Governor of the Wūgǔ tribe, reported a victory in suppressing Cházhālà.
On *gēngxū* (day),
Yēlǜ Wòtèlá, Administrator of the Northern Chancellery Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Commander-in-chief (*Dūtǒng*).
Yēlǜ Tūwū, the Yílíbì, was made Vice Commander (*Fùtǒng*).
Yēlǜ Húlǚ, General-in-chief of the Dragon and Tiger Guard, was made Military Superintendent.
They were sent to suppress Mógǔsī.
Xiāo Jiūlǐ, Administrator of the Jìqìng Palace, was sent to supervise the campaign.
On *xīnhài* (day),
Xiǔgē reported that the Pǒlǐbā tribe came to invade.
They were defeated.
On *jǐsì* (day),
the rent and taxes for the refugees of Yùtián and Mìyún were remitted for one year.
Intercalary month, *gēngzǐ* (day).
Money was granted to the poor people of the Northwest Circuit.
The two tribes Dálǐdǐ and Básīmǔ came to surrender.
5th month, *jiǎchén* (day).
The imperial carriage stopped at Chìlè Lǐng.
On *jiǎyín* (day),
horses were tallied.
On *wùwǔ* (day),
the Northwest Circuit Recruiting Commission reported that the Díliè and other tribes came to invade.
The Military Commission sent troops to engage in battle,
but were unsuccessful.
The Recruiting Commission used troops to defeat them.
Yēlǜ Àinú, Grand Preceptor of the Dūnmù Palace, and his son died from this.
On *xīnyǒu* (day),
Xiāo Āliè, Administrator of the Empress’s Maternal Relatives Commissioner, was concurrently placed in charge of the military affairs of the Northwest Circuit.
6th month, *xīnwèi* (day).
Sòng dispatched an envoy to express thanks for the condolences and sacrifices.
On *yǐyǒu* (day),
Xiǔgē, Military Commissioner of Wūgǔ Díliè, committed a crime
and was dismissed from office.
On *bǐngxū* (day),
the Hèliègě and other tribes came to establish relations.
On *guǐsì* (day),
Tìdé came to present tribute.
On *jǐhài* (day),
border residents were forbidden from intermarrying with the foreign tribes.
This summer,
Wùn, King of Gāolì (Koryŏ), died.
His son, Yù, dispatched an envoy to announce this.
An envoy was immediately dispatched with funeral gifts.
Autumn, 7th month, *gēngzǐ* (day), beginning of the month.
Hunted at Chì Shān.
This month,
the Zǔbǔ and others plundered Dǎotā Lǐng.
They completely carried away the communal herds and horses of the Western Circuit.
Yēlǜ Shíliǔ, Military Commissioner of the Northeast Circuit, pursued them with troops,
recovered everything that had been plundered, and returned.
9th month, *jǐwèi* (day).
Tè mò, King of the Southern Chancellery, was made Commissioner of the Southern Chancellery Bureau of Military Affairs.
On *jiǎzǐ* (day),
the various chiefs of Díliè came to surrender,
and their crimes were pardoned.
This month,
Wòtèlá defeated Mógǔsī.
Winter, 10th month, *bǐngzǐ* (day).
The imperial carriage stopped at Ǒusī Diàn.
On *rénwǔ* (day),
Xiāo Ālǔdài, Assistant Deputy Commissioner of Shānběi Circuit, due to his merits in suppressing Dálǐdǐ,
was promoted to General-in-chief of the Left Imperial Insignia Guard.
On *guǐsì* (day),
the Northwest Circuit Military Commission captured Pāisāgě and Púlǔ, Zǔbǔ chiefs, and presented them (to the court).
11th month, *yǐsì* (day).
Tóngguā of Tìdé and Díliè of Zǔbǔ, and others, came to surrender.
Dálǐdǐ and Básīmǔ, and others, again came to invade.
Ālǔdài, Assistant Deputy Commissioner of Shānběi, defeated them.
12th month, *guǐyǒu* (day).
Sūn Bīn, a resident of Sānhé County, and his wife were both one hundred years old.
Their households were exempted (from labor/taxation).
On *jiǎxū* (day),
Zhào Tíngmù, Policy Counsellor, was concurrently made Auxiliary Administrator of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
Wáng Shīrú, Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Policy Counsellor and concurrently Auxiliary Administrator of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
On *jǐmǎo* (day),
an edict ordered the record of meritorious officers and soldiers of the Northwest Circuit, as well as those who died in battle,
who were granted posthumous titles.
On *yǐyǒu* (day),
an edict announced the change of the reign title for the following year.
Minor offenses punishable by death or less were commuted.
Furthermore, rent and taxes were remitted for the poor.
On *wùzǐ* (day),
the Northwest Circuit Military Commission reported a victory in suppressing Mógǔsī.
Annals, Chapter 26, Dàozōng 6th Year
Shòulóng 1st Year (1075 CE), Spring, 1st month, *jǐhài* (day).
Went to Hùntóng Jiāng.
On *gēngxū* (day),
the Southwest Recruiting Commission reported that Básīmǔ came to invade.
Xiāo Ālǔdài and others defeated them.
On *yǐmǎo* (day),
relief was provided to the poor people of Fèngshèng Zhōu.
2nd month, *wùchén* (day).
Money was granted to the poor people of the Two Pìshì (Bischü) of the Left and Right.
On *guǐyǒu* (day),
Gāolì dispatched an envoy to present tribute.
On *yǐhài* (day),
the imperial carriage stopped at Yú'ér Luò.
3rd month, *bǐngwǔ* (day).
Silk was granted to the poor people of the Northeast Circuit.
Summer, 4th month, *dīngmǎo* (day).
Wòtèlá reported a victory in suppressing Yēdǔguā.
On *yǐhài* (day),
the Nǚzhí dispatched an envoy to present tribute.
On *gēngyín* (day),
meritorious officers and soldiers of the Northwest Circuit were recorded.
5th month, *yǐwèi* (day), beginning of the month.
Yēlǜ Tǔwū, the Left Yílíbì, was made Tìyǐn.
Yēlǜ Tèmò, Commissioner of the Nánjīng Court of Imperial Insignia, was made King of the Northern Chancellery.
On *guǐmǎo* (day),
posthumous titles were granted to those killed in battle.
On *dīngsì* (day),
the imperial carriage stopped at Tèlǐ Lǐng.
6th month, *jǐsì* (day).
Huílǐbù, Administrator of the King of the Six Xī Tribes, was made King of that tribe.
Zhào Xiàoyán, acting Policy Counsellor, was made Chief Commissioner of the Han People's Traveling Palace.
Sǎbā, Chief Administrator of the Imperial Hunting Grounds, due to his merit in suppressing the Zǔbǔ,
was promoted to General-in-chief Who Guards the State.
On *guǐsì* (day),
Tūlǐdǐ and Túmùgě, Zǔbǔ chiefs, came to present tribute.
Autumn, 7th month, *gēngzǐ* (day).
Měngdásī, Zǔbǔ chief, and others came to present tribute.
On *guǐmǎo* (day),
hunted at Shā Lǐng.
On *guǐchǒu* (day),
the Pǒlǐbā tribe came to submit,
and presented local products.
On *jiǎyín* (day),
Wòtèlá reported a victory over Mógǔsī.
9th month, *jiǎyín* (day).
Sacrifices were offered at Mùyè Shān.
On *bǐngchén* (day),
an edict ordered the artillerymen and crossbowmen of Xījīng to instruct the Han army of the Northwest Circuit.
, the imperial retinue halted at Ǒusīdiàn
. Day *jiǎxū*
, Yēlǜ Dàbēinú, the Northern *Línyá*, was appointed Right *Yílíbì*
. Day *guǐwèi*
, Wáng Shīrú, Auxiliary Official to the Administration (Cānzhī Zhèngshì), was appointed Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs (Shūmì Fùshǐ)
, and Zhào Xiàoyán, General Commandant of the Han People’s Traveling Palace, was appointed Auxiliary Official to the Administration (Cānzhī Zhèngshì)
. Day *rénchén*
, meritorious officers and soldiers who had campaigned against the Zǔbǔ were recorded
. The eleventh month, day *bǐngshēn*
, the Nǚzhí sent envoys to present horses
. Day *jǐhài*
, Wòtèlá, the Commander-in-Chief (Dūtǒng), was appointed Commissioner of Pacification for the Northwest Circuit (Xīběi Lù Zhāotǎo Shǐ)
, and was enfeoffed as the Prince (Jùnwáng) of Qīshuǐ
. Day *jiǎchén*
, the state of Xià presented Buddhist scriptures written on *bèiduōyè* leaves
. Day *gēngshēn*
, Yù, the King of Gāolì (Goryeo), fell ill
, and his uncle Yóng was ordered to provisionally manage state affairs
. The twelfth month, day *guǐhài*, the new moon

, Yēlǜ Āsī, Manager of the Affairs of the Northern Chancellery of Military Affairs (Zhī Běiyuàn Shūmì Shǐ Shì), was appointed Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Northern Chancellery (Běiyuàn Shūmì Shǐ)
. In this year
, Chén Héngfǔ and 130 other successful candidates (*jìnshì*) were released (appointed to office)
[The second year.] Spring, the first month, day *jiǎwǔ*
, went to the spring hunting ground (Chūnshuǐ)
. Day *guǐmǎo*
, the Pacification Office of the Southwest Region campaigned against Bāsīmǔ
and defeated them
. Day *yǐmǎo*
, the imperial retinue halted at Sènísī
. Day *xīnyǒu*
, oxen were purchased and distributed to the impoverished people of the Wūgǔ, Díliè, and Wēiwūgǔ tribes
. The second month, day *guǐhài*
, relief was given to the Dámálǐbiégǔ tribe
Summer, the fourth month, day *jǐmǎo*
, relief was given to the troops on the northwest frontier
. The sixth month, day *xīnyǒu*
, the imperial retinue halted at Sālǐnǎi
. Autumn, the seventh month, day *jiǎwǔ*
, the Zǔbǔ came to pay tribute
. Day *bǐngwǔ*
, hunted at Chìshān
. The eighth month, day *yǐchǒu*
, the Pōlǐbā tribe presented horses
. The ninth month, day *bǐngwǔ*
, the Wūgǔ Díliè tribe was moved to the Wūnà River
, in order to control the strategic point on the northern frontier
. Winter, the tenth month, day *wùchén*
, the imperial retinue halted at Ǒusīdiàn
. Day *gēngchén*
, Gāolì sent envoys to come and pay tribute
. The twelfth month, day *jǐwèi*
, Wòtèlá campaigned against Měilíjí
and defeated them
. Day *rénxū*
, Yēlǜ Duóluōwò, Chancellor of the Southern Administration (Nán Fǔ Zǎixiàng), retired from office
. Day *guǐhài*
, Xiāo Tàbùyě was appointed Chancellor of the Administration
, and Yēlǜ Dàbēinú was appointed General Inspector of the Palace Guard (Diànqián Dūdiǎnjiǎn)
. Day *yǐhài*
, the state of Xià presented captives taken from Sòng
[The third year.] Spring, the first month, day *dīnghài*
, went to the spring hunting ground (Chūnshuǐ)
. Day *rén'yín*
, Yēlǜ Chénjiānú, Military Governor (Jiédù Shǐ) of the Wūgǔ tribe, was promoted to Vice Director of the Right (Shàngshū Yòu Púshè) for his merit
. Day *guǐmǎo*
, the imperial retinue halted at Shuāngshān
. The second month, day *bǐngchén*, the new moon
, there was flooding in Nánjīng
, and envoys were dispatched to provide relief
. The intercalary month, day *bǐngwǔ*
, Měngsāgě, chief of the Zǔbǔ; Tūgǔsā, chief of the Niánbāgě; Hūlǔbā, chief of the Měilíjí, and others requested to return to their former lands
and offered regional tribute
; permission was granted
. The third month, day *xīnyǒu*
, Yánxǐ, the King of Yān, fathered a son
. Day *guǐhài*
, he was granted the name Tàlǔ
. Chánggē, the father of the consort, was promoted to Supreme General (Shàng Jiāngjūn) of the Left Gate Guard (Zuǒ Jiānmén Wèi)
, and officials and subordinates were furthermore bestowed money
. In this spring
, Yù, the King of Gāolì, passed away
. Summer, the fourth month
, Zhào Tíngmù, Chancellor of the Southern Administration, was sent out to manage the affairs of Xīngzhōng Prefecture (Zhī Xīngzhōng Fǔ Shì)
, and Niú Wēnshū, Auxiliary Official to the Administration, concurrently managed the affairs of the Bureau of Military Affairs (Tóngzhī Shūmìyuàn Shì)
. The fifth month, day *guǐhài*
, Wòtèlá campaigned against the Zǔbǔ
and defeated them
. Day *jǐsì*
, the imperial retinue halted at Sālǐnǎi
. The sixth month, day *jiǎshēn*
, an edict abolished the rapid postal delivery of new tribute items from all circuits
. Day *bǐngxū*
, an edict stipulated that wherever the imperial retinue halted each winter
, Chancellors and officials below them who constructed residences
must not conscript the people for labor
. Day *xīnchǒu*
, people from Xià came to report that Sòng was fortifying strategic locations
, so envoys were sent to Sòng
to instruct them to make peace with Xià
. Day *gēngxū*
, Yēlǜ Wúyě, General Commandant of the Qìdān Traveling Palace, was appointed Grand King of the Southern Chancellery (Nányuàn Dàwáng)
. Autumn, the seventh month, day *rénzǐ*, the new moon
, hunted at Hēilǐng
. The eighth month, day *jǐhài*
, the chief of the Púlú Máodàn tribe led his people to submit
. Day *yǐsì*
, a comet appeared in the west
. The ninth month, day *rénshēn*
, the imperial retinue halted at Ǒusīdiàn
. Day *dīngchǒu*
, Liáng Yuán, Military Governor of the Wǔdìng Army, was appointed General Commandant of the Han People’s Traveling Palace
. Day *wùyín*
, Wòtèlá reported a rapid victory in campaigning against Měilíjí
. Day *jǐmǎo*
, the chiefs of the Five States (Wǔguó) came to pay tribute
. Winter, the tenth month, day *gēngxū*
, Wòtèlá, Commissioner of Pacification for the Northwest Circuit, was appointed Chancellor of the Southern Administration
. The eleventh month, day *yǐmǎo*
, the Púlú Máodàn tribe came to pay tribute
. Day *wùwǔ*
, the monk Zhìdá from Mt. Yīwūlǘ was summoned via an imperial carriage (*ānchē*)
. Day *jǐwèi*
, Hán Zīràng, Defender-in-Chief of the Central Capital (Zhōngjīng Liúshǒu), was appointed Manager of the Affairs of the Bureau of Military Affairs
, and Xiāo Yàoshīnú, Assistant Manager of the Affairs of the Southern Chancellery of Military Affairs (Tóngzhī Nányuàn Shūmì Shǐ Shì), was appointed Manager of the Affairs of the Right *Yílíbì*
. Day *dīngchǒu*
, the General Command Office of the Northwest Circuit reported a rapid victory in campaigning against Měilíjí
[The fourth year.] Spring, the first month, day *rénzǐ*
, went to Yúér Luò
. Day *jǐsì*
, the impoverished people of the Zǔbǔ and other groups were moved to the area south of the mountains (Shānqián)
. Day *xīnwèi*
, Sòng sent envoys to present silk brocades
. The third month, day *gēngwǔ*
, traveled to Chūnzhōu
. Day *bǐngzǐ*
, the relevant office reported that the Yellow River (Huáng Hé) was clear
. Summer, the fourth month, day *xīnchǒu*
, due to rain
, hunting was suspended
. The fifth month, day *guǐyǒu*
, Nàyě reported a victory on the northern frontier
. Day *jiǎxū*
, the imperial retinue halted at Sālǐnǎi
. The sixth month, day *wùyín*, the new moon
, the state of Xià was attacked by Sòng
, and sent envoys to request aid
. Day *dīnghài*
, Nièlǐ, Military Governor of the Liáoxīng Army, was appointed *Tìyǐn*
, and Yēlǜ Guōsān, former Manager of the Affairs of the *Tìyǐn* (Qián Zhī Tìyǐn Shì), was appointed Military Commissioner of Nánjīng
. Day *jiǎwǔ*
, Niú Wēnshū, Auxiliary Official to the Administration, concurrently managed the affairs of the Defender-in-Chief of the Central Capital
. Autumn, the seventh month, day *wùwǔ*
, went to Hēilǐng
. Winter, the tenth month, day *yǐhài*, the new moon
, the imperial retinue halted at Ǒusīdiàn
. Day *jǐmǎo*
, Wòtèlá, Chancellor of the Southern Administration, concurrently served as General Commandant of the Qìdān Traveling Palace
, in order to instruct and guide Yánxǐ, the King of Yān
. The eleventh month, day *yǐsì*, the new moon
, Xiāo Yàoshīnú, Manager of the Affairs of the Right *Yílíbì*, and Yēlǜ Yǎn, Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs (Shūmì Zhí Xuéshì), were sent as envoys to Sòng
to suggest making peace with Xià
. Day *xīnyǒu*
, Xià again sent envoys to request aid
. The twelfth month, day *rénchén*
, the Rebirth Ceremony (*zàishēng lǐ*) was performed for Yánxǐ, the King of Yān
, and an exceptional pardon was granted to prisoners within 300 *lǐ*
[The fifth year.] Spring, the first month, day *yǐsì*
, went to Yúér Luò
. Day *jǐyǒu*
, an imperial edict commanded Lǐ Qiánshùn, the King of Xià, to attack the Bāsīmǔ and other tribes
. Summer, the fifth month, day *rénxū*
, Yàoshīnú and the others returned from their mission to Sòng
and reported that Sòng had ceased military action
. Day *guǐhài*
, visited Qián Líng (the mausoleum)
. Day *wùchén*
, Wòtèlá, Chancellor of the Southern Administration, concurrently served as Commissioner of Pacification for the Northwest Circuit
and Commander-in-Chief of the Imperial Guards (Jīnjūn Dūtǒng)
. Day *jǐsì*
, the imperial retinue halted along Yánliǔ Hú
. The sixth month, day *jiǎshēn*
, Huílíbǎo, Grand King of the Six Xī Tribes, was appointed General Commandant of the Qìdān Traveling Palace
; Xiāo Yàoshīnú, Manager of the Affairs of the Right *Yílíbì*, was appointed Southern *Línyá*
, and concurrently managed the affairs of the General Commandant of the Qìdān Traveling Palace
. Day *yǐwèi*
, the chiefs of the Five States came to court
. Day *wùxū*
, the Zǔbǔ came to pay tribute
. Day *jǐhài*
, Yēlǜ Hǎojiānú, Envoy of the Xīngshèng Palace, was appointed Right *Yílíbì*
. Autumn, the seventh month, day *rén'yín*, the new moon
, Tūdī, chief of the Tìdé, and others came to pay tribute
. Day *xīnhài*
, traveled to Dàláogǔ Shān. The intercalary ninth month, day *bǐngzǐ*
In the fourth year, spring, first month, on the *rénzǐ* day,
went to Yú'érluò.
On the *jǐsì* day,
moved the poor people of Zǔbǔ and others to Shānqián.
On the *xīnwèi* day,
the Sòng dispatched an envoy to present brocade and silk.
Third month, on the *gēngwǔ* day,
visited Chūnzhōu.
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
the officials in charge reported that the Yellow River had cleared.
Summer, fourth month, on the *xīnchǒu* day,
due to rain,
hunting was suspended.
Fifth month, on the *guǐyǒu* day,
Nàyě reported a victory on the northern frontier.
On the *jiǎxū* day,
stayed at Sālǐnǎi.
Sixth month, on the *wùyín* day (the first day of the month),
the Xià kingdom was attacked by Sòng,
and sent an envoy to request aid.
On the *dīnghài* day,
Nèilǐ, the Jìedùshǐ of Liáoxīngjūn, was appointed Tìyǐn,
and Yēlǜ Guōsān, formerly in charge of Tìyǐn affairs, was appointed Nánjīng Tǒngjūnshǐ.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day,
Niú Wēnshū, a Cānzhīzhèngshì, was additionally appointed in charge of the Liúshǒu of Zhōngjīng.
Autumn, seventh month, on the *wùwǔ* day,
went to Hēilǐng.
Winter, tenth month, on the *yǐhài* day (the first day of the month),
stayed at Ǒusīdànd.
On the *jǐmǎo* day,
Wòtèlā, the Nánfǔ Zǎixiàng, was additionally appointed Dūbùshǔ of the Qìdān Xínggōng,
to instruct Yānguówáng Yánxǐ.
Eleventh month, on the *yǐsì* day (the first day of the month),
Xiāo Yàoshīnǔ, in charge of Yòuyílíbì affairs, and Yēlǜ Yǎn, a Shūmì Zhíxuéshì, were dispatched as envoys to Sòng,
to subtly suggest peace with Xià.
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
Xià again dispatched an envoy to request aid.
Twelfth month, on the *rénchén* day,
a regeneration ceremony was performed for Yānguówáng Yánxǐ,
and a general amnesty was granted to prisoners within three hundred *lǐ*.
In the fifth year, spring, first month, on the *yǐsì* day,
went to Yú'érluò.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
an imperial edict ordered Xiàguówáng Lǐ Qiánshùn to attack the Básīmǔ and other tribes.
Summer, fifth month, on the *rénxū* day,
Yàoshīnǔ and others returned from their mission to Sòng,
reporting that Sòng had ceased military action.
On the *guǐhài* day,
visited the Qiánlíng tomb.
On the *wùchén* day,
Wòtèlā, the Nánfǔ Zǎixiàng, was additionally appointed Xīběilù Zhāotǎoshǐ,
and Jīnjūn Dūwěi.
On the *jǐsì* day,
stayed at Yánliǔhú.
Sixth month, on the *jiǎshēn* day,
Huílíbǎo, the Dàwáng of the Xī Lìubù, was appointed Qìdān Xínggōng Dūbùshǔ,
and Xiāo Yàoshīnǔ, in charge of Yòuyílíbì affairs, was appointed Nánmiàn Línyá,
and additionally in charge of Qìdān Xínggōng Dūbùshǔ affairs.
On the *yǐwèi* day,
the tribal chiefs of Wǔguó came to court.
On the *wùxū* day,
Zǔbǔ came to pay tribute.
On the *jǐhài* day,
Yēlǜ Hǎojiānú, the Xīngshènggōngshǐ, was appointed Yòuyílíbì.
Autumn, seventh month, on the *rénzǐ* day (the first day of the month),
Tìdécháng Tūdī and others came to pay tribute.
On the *xīnhài* day,
went to Dàláogǔshān.
Intercalary ninth month, on the *bǐngzǐ* day,
stayed at Dúlújīn.
Winter, tenth month, on the *jǐhài* day (the first day of the month),
Gāolíwáng Yóng dispatched an envoy to request investiture.
On the *dīngsì* day,
Wòtèlā reported a victory in the campaign against Yēdúguā.
On the *bǐngyín* day,
Xiāo Délǐdǐ, the Tóngzhī Nánjīngliúshǒushì, was appointed Zhī Běiyuàn Shūmìshǐshì.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
Sòng dispatched Guō Zhīzhāng and Cáo Píng to convey good wishes.
On the *wùchén* day,
relief was provided to the famine-stricken in Liáozhōu,
and their rent and taxes were remitted for one year.
Eleventh month, on the *jiǎxū* day,
relief was provided to the Nán and Běi Èrjiū.
On the *yǐyǒu* day,
the Xià kingdom, because Sòng had ceased military action,
dispatched an envoy to express gratitude.
Twelfth month, on the *jiǎzǐ* day,
Zhào Xiàoyán, a Cānzhīzhèngshì, was appointed Hànrén Xínggōng Dūbùshǔ,
and Liáng Yuán, the Hànrén Xínggōng Dūbùshǔ, was appointed Liáoxīngjūn Jìedùshǐ.
In the sixth year, spring, first month, on the *guǐyǒu* day,
Yēlǜ Wúyě, the Nányuàn Dàwáng, passed away.
On the *rénwǔ* day,
Tūkāiqǐ, a Tàishī who had retired from office, was appointed Xī Lìubù Dàwáng.
On the *dīnghài* day,
went to Chūnshuǐ.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
Wòtèlā captured Mógǔsī and presented him.
On the *bǐngshēn* day,
an imperial edict inquired about the people's hardships.
Second month, on the *dīngwèi* day,
Chénjiānú, the Wūgǔbù Jìedùshǐ, was appointed Nányuàn Dàwáng.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
Mógǔsī was executed by dismemberment in the marketplace.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
silk was distributed to the poor people of Wǔyuàn.
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
Sòng dispatched an envoy to announce that Sòngzhǔ Xù had passed away,
and his younger brother Jí had succeeded to the throne;
on the same day, an envoy was dispatched to offer condolences.
Third month, on the *jiǎshēn* day,
the prohibitions on mountains and forests in Shuòzhōu were relaxed.
Summer, fourth month, on the *dīngyǒu* day (the first day of the month),
there was a solar eclipse.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
went to Tànshān.
Fifth month, on the *rénwǔ* day,
the Wūgǔbù attacked Cházhálà,
and defeated them.
On the *yǐyǒu* day,
Zhào Xiàoyán, the Hànrén Xínggōng Dūbùshǔ, passed away.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
stayed at Nàgáluò.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
Sòng dispatched an envoy to present relics of the late Emperor.
On the *yǐwèi* day,
Hé Lǔsǎogǔ, the Dōngjīng Liúshǒu, was appointed Tìyǐn,
and Xiāo Chánggē, the Nányuàn Xuānhuīshǐ, was appointed Hànrén Xínggōng Dūbùshǔ.
Sixth month, on the *gēngzǐ* day,
an envoy was dispatched to congratulate the Sòngzhǔ.
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
because the official documents of the authorities recorded the Sòng Emperor's
"succeeding to the throne"
as
"ascending the precious throne,"
an imperial edict stripped Zǎixiàng Zhèng Zhuān and others below him of their offices,
and dismissed Zhuān to be in charge of Xīngzhōngfǔ affairs,
Hán Zīràng to be Jìedùshǐ of Chóngyìjūn,
and Yùshǐzhōngchéng Hán Jūnyì to be Jìedùshǐ of Guǎngshùnjūn.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
the Zǔbǔ chieftain came to pay tribute.
On the *wùwǔ* day,
an envoy was dispatched to resolve outstanding prison cases in the Wǔjīng.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
Liáng Yuán, the Liáoxīngjūn Jìedùshǐ, was appointed Shūmì Fùshǐ.
Autumn, seventh month, on the *gēngwǔ* day,
went to Shālǐng.
On the *rénshēn* day,
the Yēdúguā tribes raided the Xīběilù.
Eighth month,
Wòtèlā attacked and defeated them with troops,
and sent an envoy to present the victory report.
Ninth month, on the *guǐwèi* day,
observed a sacrifice at Mùyèshān.
On the *wùzǐ* day,
stayed at Ǒusīdànd.
Winter, tenth month, on the *rénzhōng* day,
Wáng Shīrú, a Shūmì Fùshǐ, was appointed supervisor of the compilation of national history.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
the tribal chiefs of Wǔguó came to pay tribute.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
because Píngzhōu was suffering from famine,
their rent and taxes were remitted for one year.
Eleventh month, on the *rénshēn* day,
as Tiāndéjūn citizen Tián Shìróng lived with three generations under one roof,
an imperial edict granted him an official post,
and ordered one of his sons to serve as Zhīhòu in the Sānbānyuàn.
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
Zhìdá, a monk from Yīwūlǘshān, was summoned to establish an altar in the inner palace.
On the *wùzǐ* day,
Xiàguówáng Lǐ Qiánshùn dispatched an envoy to request marriage to a princess.
Twelfth month, on the *yǐwèi* day,
the Nǚzhēn dispatched an envoy to pay tribute.
On the *jǐhài* day,
Hǎojiānú, in charge of Yòuyílíbì affairs, was appointed Běimiàn Línyá.
On the *xīnhài* day,
an imperial edict ordered Yānguówáng Yánxǐ to nominate officials down to the rank of Dàjiāngjūn.
On the *gēngshēn* day,
Tiělí came to pay tribute.
Sòng dispatched an envoy to express gratitude.
The Emperor was unwell.
In this year,
Gāolíwáng Yóng's eldest son, Wǔ, was enfeoffed as Sānguó Gōng.
Eighty-seven *jìnshì* including Kāng Bǐngjiǎn were released.
In the seventh year, spring, first month, on the *rénxū* day (the first day of the month),
despite his illness, the Emperor held court in Qīngfēngdiàn to receive felicitations from officials and envoys from various states.
That night,
a white vapor like a silk ribbon
descended from the sky.
Black clouds rose from the northwest,
flying swiftly and with sound.
In the north, there were blue, red, black, and white vapors,
intermingling and falling.
